mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 30 days compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of FEDFUNDS 30-day decline with 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 3.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (as indicated by high consumer spending and housing starts), a decline in residential investment (HOUST) signals weakening demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST decline > 0.5% in 1 month fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 100 fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS year-over-year decline fails to predict negative 5-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5% fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% combined with a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals an economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS decline > 0.5% fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances.
